title: Exotic Tender Argentinian Dates Empanadas
description: A festive Argentinian dish featuring stoned dates, these empanadas are nutty and tender, perfect for a special occasion, and are shojin-friendly.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the flour, salt, and sugar.
Add the olive oil, vanilla extract, and cinnamon to the bowl and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces and roll each piece into a ball.
Roll out each ball of dough into a thin circle.
Place a few stoned dates and some chopped walnuts in the center of each circle.
Fold the dough over the filling to form a half moon shape and press the edges together to seal the empanada.
Place the empanadas on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake the empanadas for 20 minutes, or until they are golden brown.
